req.title: Basic-auth requires both segments
req.statement: The system shall route /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> only when both user and passwd segments are provided.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must only route when BOTH path segments are present. Tests cover: (1) positive EP - valid credentials supplied for both segments returns 200 with correct JSON payload; (2) negative NEG - missing passwd segment causes 404 (route not matched); (3) negative NEG - missing both segments causes 404; (4) DT - wrong credentials returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate header; (5) BVA - single-character user and passwd at boundary; (6) DT - correct user but wrong passwd returns 401; (7) EP - no Authorization header returns 401. Each test asserts exact status codes and payload fields to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both user and passwd path segments are provided
Correct HTTP Basic Auth credentials are sent
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with Authorization header matching myuser:mypass
Assert JSON body contains authenticated=True and user='myuser'
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert 'user' in data
assert len(data) == 2

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_returns_200_with_payload():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_authenticated_field_is_true_not_truthy
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Valid credentials matching path segments are provided
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/admin/secret with matching Authorization header
Assert authenticated field is exactly boolean True
Assert user field is exactly string 'admin'
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'admin:secret').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/admin/secret', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data.get('authenticated') is True
assert data.get('user') == 'admin'
assert data.get('user') != 'secret'
assert data.get('user') != ''

def test_basic_auth_authenticated_field_is_true_not_truthy():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'admin:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/admin/secret', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data.get('authenticated') is True
    assert data.get('user') == 'admin'
    assert data.get('user') != 'secret'
